title: Falling blocks
description: When block is broked its fly | 1% to detonate
body:
Falling Blocks! (v1)

Turn your Minecraft world into a chaotic physics playground!

Ever felt like mining was a bit too... stationary? Falling Blocks completely overhauls how blocks behave when broken. Instead of simply dropping as items, every block becomes a physical projectile with a mind of its own—and sometimes, a very short fuse.

✨ Key Features

Kinetic Launching: Every block you break (in Survival OR Creative) launches into the air.

Smart Pathfinding: If you're mining in a tight tunnel, the blocks won't just hit the ceiling and disappear. They "intelligently" look for an opening and fly out to the side or into the corridor.

Impact Physics: Blocks no longer "re-solidify" on the ground. When they land, they break apart into collectible loot with custom sounds and particles.

The "Boom" Factor: There is a 1% random chance that any falling block will transform into a Primed TNT the moment it hits the ground.

Massive Chain Reactions: When a block explodes, it triggers a Blast Wave. Any block within a 7-block radius has a 95% chance to be launched into the air, creating epic, mountain-leveling cascades of chaos.

🛠 Commands & Interaction

/fall next: Guarantees that the very next block you break will trigger a TNT explosion on impact.

Seamless Integration: Includes a "tnt test mode v1" welcome message to let you know the chaos is ready to go.

⚙️ Technical Details

Version: Minecraft 1.21.1

Platform: Fabric API

Optimized Physics: Uses a custom tracking system to ensure smooth entity animations and prevent "ghost blocks" or teleportation glitches.

Warning: Not recommended for those who value their beautiful wooden houses. One wrong click and the whole neighborhood might just fly away!
